expectations.text: All prospect URLs are scraped individually via Firecrawl
expectations.evidence: All 3 prospect URLs scraped individually. wordpress.org accessible, blogdumoderateur returned binary (anti-bot), kinsta returned 404.

expectations.text: Each prospect receives its own distinct analysis (not copy-pasted)
expectations.evidence: Each prospect has unique analysis: wordpress.org (dev blog, technical, zero CRM overlap), BDM (inaccessible, anti-bot), Kinsta (404 but broken link opportunity). Different signaux de prudence, different alternatives.

expectations.text: Qualifications vary across prospects based on actual fit (not all rated the same)
expectations.evidence: Three different qualifications: 'A eviter' (wordpress.org), 'Faible' (BDM), 'A eviter actuellement / potentiellement Tres pertinente' (Kinsta). Each justified differently.

expectations.text: A batch summary file is generated with qualification overview
expectations.evidence: 2026-04-06_batch-summary.md generated with qualification table, alerte critique (page schoolsWP 404), and 5 actions prioritaires.

expectations.text: Each prospect follows the complete output format from the skill
expectations.evidence: All 3 prospect reports follow the exact skill format: Prospect, Analyse du prospect, Analyse de la page a promouvoir, Qualification, Email principal, Note strategique.

expectations.text: Language adapts per prospect (English for wordpress.org, French for FR prospects)
expectations.evidence: All analyses written in French including wordpress.org. The 'Langue probable de contact' is correctly set to 'anglais' for wordpress.org, but since no email was written (all disqualified), language adaptation of the email couldn't be verified. The analysis text itself is in the user's language (French) which is acceptable.

suggestions.assertion: Language adapts per prospect (English for wordpress.org, French for FR prospects)
suggestions.reason: This assertion can't be properly tested when all prospects are disqualified (no emails written). Need at least one qualifying English-language prospect to test language adaptation.
No assertion checks the quality of the batch summary table — the with_skill version produced a well-structured overview with actions prioritaires, which is a differentiator.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong batch processing. Skill format consistently applied across all 3 prospects. Language assertion untestable due to all prospects being disqualified.
